title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The headline establishes that a lawyer in Minnesota was suspended in connection with fake case citations attributed to AI use. Beyond that, the specific AI system involved, the court or proceeding affected, the number of citations at issue, and the precise disciplinary findings are not available from the material provided.

What the headline does indicate is a failure mode that has appeared in other documented incidents: a generative AI system producing plausible-sounding but fabricated legal citations, which a practitioner then submitted without independently verifying each reference against an authoritative legal database. That verification step, a routine part of legal practice before AI tools existed, is where the failure would have been caught.

Whether the suspension reflects a finding of intentional misconduct or negligence, and what the AI system's role was relative to the lawyer's own review process, is not established by the available reporting.
